snippet.title: First Age - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the First Age announcement trailer for the upcoming turn-based strategy card game set in the Neolithic Age. Sacrifice villagers, tame mammoths, and build powerful card synergies to lead your tribe through the threat of the Dark Ages. Will your people stand the test of time? First Age will be available on PC.
